# RAX — RealApp Super-Suite

> An unofficial analytics and scouting terminal for Real Sports (realapp.com) cards, Rax, On-This-Day claims and prediction markets. Not affiliated with Real. Not financial advice.

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, public, read-only, no auth): https://rax.vivaanshahani.com/mcp
- Setup for Instinct, Claude, Cursor, VS Code: https://github.com/GeoWizard4645/rax/blob/main/docs/MCP.md
- Site guide (every tab, every parameter): https://github.com/GeoWizard4645/rax/blob/main/docs/SITE-GUIDE.md
- Assistant (chat bubble) design and limits: https://github.com/GeoWizard4645/rax/blob/main/docs/ASSISTANT.md
- Docs search without an AI: https://rax.vivaanshahani.com/api/docs/search?q=legendary+3+multiplier
- Real's own docs (the primary source): https://docs.realapp.link/llms.txt

## Tabs
- /rateboard — Rateboard offer board wrapper
- /scout — bids-above-market radar and proactive scout
- /volatility — demand spikes, bid-rate history, Monte Carlo
- /portfolio — earnings audit, CDN assets
- /quads — Quads matchups and polls
- /efficiency — OTD Efficiency: best cards/rarity per Rax spent
- /calendar — OTD calendar
- /edge — Edge / EV from Kalshi, Polymarket, DraftKings vs Real's percentage
